input: How long does a credit card refund take?
expected_output: A credit card refund takes 5 to 10 business days after approval, and it can appear on the next statement.

input: Mere debit card ka refund kitne din me aayega?
expected_output: Debit card refunds take 3 to 7 business days after approval.

input: I paid by boleto. How do I get my refund and how long does it take?
expected_output: Boleto refunds take 5 to 8 business days after the customer sends their bank account details.

input: Maine voucher se pay kiya tha, refund kaise milega?
expected_output: Orders paid with a voucher are refunded immediately as voucher balance.

input: What is the return window?
expected_output: Most items can be returned within 30 calendar days after the delivery date, if they are unused and in the original packaging with tags and accessories.

input: I changed my mind about a shirt. How much do I get back and what does the return cost me?
expected_output: For change of mind only the item price is refunded, not the shipping fee. If the KartNest return label is used, R$ 15 is deducted from the refund.

input: Can I return opened underwear because I don't like it?
expected_output: No. Opened underwear, swimwear and personal hygiene items cannot be returned for change of mind. They can still be returned if defective, damaged or different from the description.

input: My phone arrived defective. Who pays the return shipping and how long do I have to report it?
expected_output: Return shipping is free for defective items. The problem must be reported within 7 calendar days after delivery, with photos of the item, label and packaging.

input: The order says delivered but I never got the package. What should I do?
expected_output: Wait 2 business days and check with neighbors or building reception. If it still has not arrived, open a claim within 15 calendar days after the delivered date. The investigation takes up to 7 business days, and if the package is lost the customer gets a full refund including shipping, or a replacement.

input: Up to what amount is a refund approved automatically?
expected_output: Refunds up to R$ 150 are approved automatically if the order and tracking data confirm the case. Above R$ 150 up to R$ 800 a human agent decides within 2 business days, and above R$ 800 the senior support team decides within 5 business days.

input: I made 3 refund requests in the last two months. Will the next small one be approved automatically?
expected_output: No. A customer with 3 or more refund requests in the last 60 days always gets a human review, whatever the amount.

input: Can you guarantee that my refund will be approved?
expected_output: No. The assistant cannot promise approval. It can say whether a request is eligible and what happens next, and the final decision follows the approval rules.

input: How many days does delivery take to the North region?
expected_output: Delivery to the North and Northeast regions typically takes 10 to 18 business days after payment approval.

input: My order is 12 days past the estimated delivery date and still not delivered. Can I get my money back?
expected_output: Yes. If the order is more than 10 calendar days past the estimated delivery date and still not delivered, the customer can cancel and get a full refund including shipping.

input: My order arrived 9 days later than estimated. Do I get anything for the delay?
expected_output: Yes. An order delivered more than 7 calendar days after the estimated date gets a R$ 20 voucher valid for 90 days, added automatically within 3 business days after delivery.

input: What does the order status 'unavailable' mean?
expected_output: The seller could not supply the item, so the order cannot be fulfilled. The full amount is refunded automatically.

input: What does the status 'invoiced' mean?
expected_output: It means the invoice for the order was issued.

input: Can I cancel my order after it has shipped?
expected_output: No. Once an order has shipped it cannot be canceled. It can be returned after delivery under the returns policy.

input: How can I change the delivery address of my order?
expected_output: The address can only be changed before the order ships, and only through a human agent. The assistant cannot change addresses.

input: I did not pay my boleto. What happens to my order?
expected_output: A boleto is valid for 3 days. An order whose boleto is not paid within 3 days after it was created is canceled automatically.

input: How many installments can I choose, and is there a minimum amount?
expected_output: Credit card payments can be split in up to 10 installments, and installments under R$ 10 are not allowed.

input: Do vouchers expire? Can I turn them into cash?
expected_output: Late-delivery vouchers are valid for 90 days and other vouchers for 180 days. Vouchers cannot be exchanged for cash.

input: I was charged twice for the same order. What now?
expected_output: The assistant cannot see bank statements. For a duplicate charge the customer should ask for a human agent, so the payments team can check it.

input: Will your assistant ever ask me for my card number or password?
expected_output: No. The assistant never asks for passwords, full card numbers, CVV, card PINs or one-time codes, and KartNest staff will never ask for them either.

input: What are your human support hours?
expected_output: Human support works Monday to Saturday, 09:00 to 18:00 Brasilia time. Outside these hours the case is saved and an agent replies within 1 business day.

input: Can you place an order for me?
expected_output: No. The assistant cannot place orders. Customers should use the KartNest website or app.

input: I want all my personal data deleted from KartNest.
expected_output: Data requests are handled by a human agent, because the assistant cannot process them. The customer should ask for a human agent.

input: Seller kitne din me order ship karta hai?
expected_output: Sellers must hand the package to the carrier within 3 business days after the payment is approved.

input: After my returned item reaches you, how long until the refund is sent?
expected_output: Inspection takes 2 to 3 business days after the returned item arrives, then the refund is sent to the original payment method.

input: I used the product and damaged it myself. Can I still get a refund?
expected_output: No. Items returned used, damaged by the customer, or without their accessories are not eligible for a refund.

input: Do you ship to Portugal?
expected_output: The assistant does not have information about shipping to Portugal and suggests asking a human support agent.

input: What is the warranty period for electronics?
expected_output: The assistant does not have information about warranty periods and suggests asking a human support agent.

input: Which carrier company delivers my orders?
expected_output: The assistant does not have information about which carrier is used and suggests asking a human support agent.
